'''Eph''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Eph was a member of the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that was based in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Eph accompanied the Believers [[Crymsin Ost]] and [[Disch'l]] and the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Melo Centris]] on a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]]. They boarded a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was orbiting the planet and planned to send a virus down to it, via [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. However, they were confronted on the station by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who defeated Eph and his comrades, preventing them from releasing the virus.
